    -- ported from tests/cases/conformance/expressions/propertyAccess/propertyAccessNumericLiterals.ts
    -- dropped: real Number.prototype/lib surface (tlua ships an empty `interface Number {}`);
    --   augmented Number locally below with a `toString` member so the numeric-literal-vs-dot
    --   parsing ambiguity this test exercises still has something to call into.
    -- dropped: emit coverage (noEmit) — the local `interface Number` is a type-only shim kept so
    --   the numeric-literal-vs-dot parsing ambiguity has a member to resolve; Lua numbers have no
    --   runtime `toString` method, so the lowered `0xffffffff.toString()` / `1234..toString()`
    --   calls would not be runnable Lua.
    
    interface Number {
      toString(radix?: number): string;
    }
    
    0xffffffff.toString();
    0o01234.toString();
    0b01101101.toString();
    1234..toString();
    1e0.toString();
    000.toString();
